services.name: Sunset Boat Cruise
services.desc: Looking for a unique way to experience the island? Look no further than our night boat tour! This is a great way to see the island from a different perspective, and it’s also a great way to relax and enjoy the evening.Our night boat tours are offered every day from 7:45 PM to 8:45 PM. We offer both back bay and ocean trips, so you can choose the one that’s right for you. If you’re looking for a relaxing ride, we recommend the back bay trip. If you’re looking for a more thrilling ride, we recommend the ocean trip.‍We also offer BYO wine and cheese on our night boat tours. services.name: Banana Boat Tour
services.desc: The banana boat is a classic watersport that is sure to get your heart racing. This inflatable boat is pulled behind a speedboat, and riders hold on for dear life as they are tossed around the waves. It’s a wild and exhilarating ride that is perfect for thrill-seekers of all ages.The banana boat ride in New Jersey is the only one of its kind in the state. It’s offered every day, on the hour, from 10am to 5pm. The ride itself lasts for 30 minutes, but the entire trip is about 45 minutes, as you will need to board the boat and get situated before the ride begins.The banana boat ride is a great way to cool off on a hot day and have some fun in the sun.
